ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips, resulting in an approximate 4:1 black-to-white ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch on the outer 30% of the left lobe with diffuse mottling at the inner boundary; smaller high-intensity white region on the outer 15% of the right lobe. The central core and lower regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and several distinct macro-notches exceeding 10 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct high-contrast white annular/circular pixel clusters on the mid-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) clearly visible on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly textured, irregular brownish-white protrusions (biological encrustation) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
